facts.text: It began as Street Fighter '89. Operators said it was nothing like Street Fighter, so it was renamed before release.
Designed by Akira Nishitani and Akira Yasuda, produced by Yoshiki Okamoto: the team behind Street Fighter II two years later.
Mayor Mike Haggar, a former pro wrestler, takes on the Mad Gear gang after they kidnap his daughter Jessica.
Many enemies are named after 1980s rock musicians: Axl, Slash, Sid, Billy, Roxy and Poison.
The gang is named after Capcom's 1987 racing game Mad Gear. Hugo Andore is based on André the Giant.
Japan's highest-grossing arcade game of 1990, and Gamest's Best Game of the year.
Attack + Jump spins to clear everyone around you, but it costs a little health. Use it when you're surrounded.
Smash barrels and drums for food and weapons. Cody can stab again and again with a knife; Haggar's piledriver hits hardest.
The SNES port dropped Guy, co-op and a whole stage. Here you get all three heroes and two players.
